subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ ‘B’ and ‘C’ to write five complete sentences. 1  5 =
stimulus: Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) Television is i. are gradually i. source of entertainment of the (b) Television programmes ii. however, present world. (c) A wide range of iii. is telecast ii. they can be highly educative too. programmes of varied iv. are not only entertaining iii. has become an addiction for many. interest v. the most common and iv. on numerous channels. (d) Watching TV, widespread v. being influenced by them. Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (e) Young people's tastes
guide_solution: (a) Television is the most common and widespread source of entertainment of the present world. (b) Television programmes are not only entertaining, they can be highly educative too. (c) A wide range of programmes of varied interest is telecast on numerous channels. (d) Watching TV, however, has become an addiction for many. (e) Young people's tastes are gradually being influenced by them. → → → → → → →
